tool.name: team-execute-flow
tool.description:
Executes the caller's team's task DAG end to end (plan 239 / L4-team-execute-flow-llm-tool). The team's tasks (created via team-task-create with optional blockedBy dependencies) are scheduled and executed in dependency order; unbound members are auto-spawned when a functional member spawner is wired.
**Parameters**: none. The caller's team is resolved from the session (no teamId parameter — an LLM can only orchestrate its own team).
**Semantics**: - ACL: `execute` action requires WRITE (LEAD/MEMBER allowed, non-members denied). - Async: the tool call completes when the DAG completes (not when the synchronous call returns). - Honest results: success returns `{success:true, completedTaskIds, startOrder, completionOrder}`; a DAG node failure returns `{success:false, failedTaskId, skippedTaskIds, completedTaskIds}` so the LLM can retry or give up. Structural failures (empty task set / unknown team / cyclic blockedBy) return an explicit error. - Honest fail-loud: if team functionality or the task store is not enabled (NoOp defaults) the tool reports the flow was NOT executed — never a silent success.
